name: Nagisa Haruki
source: Haruki is an orphan who's family died three years ago in a car accident. He was taken in by the Natsume family. Haruki has a dark past. His father was a trainer for the Under Eden prostitution ring and before his death he introduced Haruki to the organisation. Haruki's only goal is to become a first class prostitution trainer and although he may look innocent and cute he is actually a very devilish and perverted child.
